conclusions.trpo_free: Exploration-scale mismatch: default log_std_init=0 (4.7x larger noise than PPO family) destroys the solvable residual prior within <10k steps; even 500k (3.3x budget) never recovers (all checkpoints 0.000, 2 seeds). Matched init (-1.5) rescues the start (0.80@10k) but conservative CG updates then erode it (0.80->0.36->0.04). Triple-seed replication: 10k = {0.80, 1.00, 0.84} -> 150k = {0.04, 0.40, 0.52}.
conclusions.trpo_seq: Structural failure: even with matched init, seq TRPO is 0.000 at every checkpoint — the three-phase hold+geometry criteria amplify any policy-mean error; TRPO cannot preserve the near-optimal zero prior on the sequential task.
conclusions.rnd: Direction conflict, not scale: intrinsic-weight ablation (0.5 vs 0.05, both tasks) yields 0.000 across the board — the single-value-head simplification lets novelty reward structurally fight the hold-window criteria regardless of weight. CONTROL: lambda=0 recovers 1.000/1.000 (free 0.30s / seq 1.14s) - wrapper and backend are harmless; the dose-response {0:1.0, 0.05:0.0, 0.5:0.0} isolates the intrinsic signal as the sole cause.
conclusions.sac_seq: Structural failure: target-entropy ablation (-16 -> -4) leaves seq SAC at 0.000; not an entropy-scale vs hold-window effect. Off-policy bootstrapping under the three-phase criteria is the mismatch (free SAC 0.96, TD3 1.0 @ 2.3s on seq).
